div.head: Ps Cn for 27.3
div.ab: Aper uero, quanquam foreste sit, nullatenus tamen animal ueneris haberi est assuetus.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 625 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)
div.ab: But the boar, although he is of the forest, has by no means been accustomed to be held a beast of venison.

note.seg: Hier scheint Verf., aus der Rolle Cnuts herausfallend, auf gegenteilige Meinungen unter den Forstkollegen hinzudeuten; s. o. 21, 2
Here the author, falling out of his role as Cnut, seems to allude to contrary opinions among his forest colleagues; see above 21, 2
